parent_evidence: I4H R3 stronger-virtual PASS; no promotion

hypotheses.primary: The conservative ABSTAIN-first I4H policy replicates a positive craft effect on a fresh source-free sample while protecting already-good scenes.
hypotheses.standard: STANDARD intervention replicates R3 gains on procedure/information-heavy scenes without voice/social harm.
hypotheses.low_subtext: LOW additive physicalization improves latent relational subtext without deleting character-bearing dialogue or social texture.

rules: do not intentionally optimize selector dimensions
control.freeze: all controls SHA sealed before selector profiling

decision_rule: ABSTAIN if max(social_texture,voice_specificity)>=3 and exposition_risk<=2 unless physicalizable_subtext==3 and proposed edit is additive LOW
STANDARD if exposition_risk>=2 and procedural_pressure>=2 and max(social_texture,voice_specificity)<=1 and already_playable<=1
LOW if physicalizable_subtext>=2 or exposition_risk>=2, unless STANDARD

LOW: do not delete character-bearing dialogue merely to shorten
STANDARD: may restructure action/dialogue for information economy

evaluation.pair_rule: Treatment win if mean >= Control mean +0.30 and no hard/protection failure; Control win if reverse or Treatment protection failure; else Tie.
evaluation.masking: locally generated secret random A/B map; only map SHA committed before scoring; mapping not opened until blind scores are Git-sealed
evaluation.same_model_claim_boundary: Same-model masked replication; not independent/human evidence.

gates.promotion_candidate_rule: Only if primary + STANDARD replication + LOW subtext replication all PASS and no chronology/integrity defect. Even then Active I4D remains until a new 5-Part/9-Package physical synchronization is built and audited.

transport_method.rule: no manual reconstruction of long prose into GitHub
